app.name: Stampd
app.tagline: Attendance, leave and requests for your team

home.title: Stampd is being built
home.body: The foundation is ready. Screens arrive with the next tickets.

notFound.title: We can't find that page
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped. Your data is safe.

crash.title: This page didn't load
crash.body: Something went wrong on our side. Try again, or reload the page.

forbidden.title: You don't have access
forbidden.body: This page is for another role. If you need it, ask your HR admin.

login.title: Log in to Stampd
login.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Log in again to pick up where you left off.

errors.deactivated: Your account is no longer active. Ask your HR admin if you think this is a mistake.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.

signup.title: Create your company account
signup.description: Set up Stampd for your team in a few minutes.
signup.name: Your name
signup.terms: I agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your work email and we’ll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {email}, we’ve sent a link to reset your password. It works for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: You’ll be logged in once it’s saved.
reset.expiredBody: Reset links work for 1 hour. Ask for a new one and use it straight away.

invite.title: Join {company}
invite.description: Check your name and choose a password to get started.
invite.name: Your name
invite.nameHint: This is how your team will see you.
invite.expiredBody: Ask your HR admin to send you a new invite.

fieldErrors.INVALID_FORMAT: Check the format of this field
fieldErrors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists
fieldErrors.WEAK_PASSWORD: Choose a password that meets all the rules
fieldErrors.GRACE_MAX: Grace can be up to 120 minutes
fieldErrors.END_BEFORE_START: End time must be after the start time
fieldErrors.NAME_TAKEN: Another leave type already has this name
fieldErrors.HOLIDAY_EXISTS: There's already a holiday on this date

rules.notPersonal: Doesn’t contain your name or email

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your details, photo, password and preferences.

photo.hint: JPG or PNG · up to 2 MB
photo.wrongType: {file} isn't supported. Use JPG or PNG.

details.title: Details
details.description: Ask HR to change anything except your phone.

password.title: Change password
password.description: You'll stay signed in here; other devices are signed out.
password.done: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

unsavedChanges.title: Discard changes?
unsavedChanges.description: You have changes that aren't saved. If you leave now, they'll be lost.

settings.title: Company settings
settings.description: Your working week, holidays, leave types and the requests employees can make.

company.saved: Settings saved. Everyone sees them from their next load.

profile.title: Company profile
profile.description: Shown in the sidebar, on invites and in emails.
profile.name: Company name
profile.timezoneHint: All times are in company time. A change applies to attendance from tomorrow.
profile.accentHint: Used only for the ring around your logo.
profile.outlineLight: Shown with an outline in light mode so it stays visible.
profile.outlineDark: Shown with an outline in dark mode so it stays visible.

logo.label: Logo
logo.hint: PNG, SVG or JPG · square · up to 1 MB
logo.wrongType: {file} isn't supported. Use PNG, SVG or JPG.

calendar.title: Work calendar
calendar.description: Decides working days, lateness and leave counts for everyone.
calendar.daysSummary: {count, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}} · {days}
calendar.pickOneDay: Pick at least one working day
calendar.appliesNextLoad: Applies to everyone from their next load.
calendar.graceHint: Check-ins within this many minutes after the start time aren't late.
calendar.leaveYearHint: Balances reset and allowances renew on the 1st of this month.

history.title: Settings history
history.description: Every change to company settings, newest first.

holidays.title: Public holidays
holidays.description: Holidays aren't working days: they don't count as leave and nobody is marked absent.
holidays.caption: Public holidays in {year}
holidays.name: Name
holidays.dialogDescription: We'll check for approved requests on that day before saving.

empty.title: No holidays in {year} yet
empty.body: Add your public holidays so leave and attendance skip them.

impact.title: {count, plural, one {# approved request is on this day} other {# approved requests are on this day}}
impact.description: They stay as they are. Open each one to cancel it with a reason, or leave it unchanged.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.description: {date} becomes a working day again for attendance and leave.

leaveTypes.title: Leave types
leaveTypes.description: What employees can take, and how each type is counted. All leave shares one colour; the icon tells types apart.
leaveTypes.dialogDescription: A change to the yearly allowance applies from the next leave year. For this year, adjust balances per employee.
leaveTypes.name: Name
leaveTypes.iconFootnote: Icons already used by other leave types are marked In use.
leaveTypes.allowanceHint: Applies from the next leave year.
leaveTypes.allowanceShort: {count, plural, one {# day a year} other {# days a year}}

archiveDialog.title: Archive {name}?
archiveDialog.description: It's been used, so it can't be deleted. Employees can't request it any more; past requests and balances stay.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.description: Nobody has used it yet, so it's removed completely.

requestTypes.title: Request types
requestTypes.description: Turn off what your company doesn't use. Changes save at once and apply to everyone.

trip.name: Business trip
trip.approver: Approved by the manager, then HR.
